Chapter 6371: Mountains Of Corpses

Chapter 6371: Mountains Of Corpses

Their fervorous determination shocked outsiders.

“Are they still disciples of Desolate Frontier?” Someone murmured.

Previously, there was no discernible distinction between them. Everyone was a part of Desolate Frontier and had a similar culture. Now, they realized that the clan members were so different.

“This is the Chen’s legacy culture.” An ancestor sighed and said: “It is infused into the members’ bones and marrows, born for this sole purpose. Offering their life is an honor.”

Others agreed with this assessment after seeing the Chen’s conviction.

“Such persistence in your wrongdoings.” Solar Monarch uttered coldly: “Have it your way then.”

He gave the order and the coalition army prepared for attack.

“Last chance, think before you act.” Dragon-pill had a softer stance.

“Born and die with the Chen, emperors included.” Lostmetal’s answer echoed across Desolate Frontier.

Although listeners didn’t agree with his choice, they couldn’t help feeling admiration. These mighty emperors were willing to die for their clan.

“March.” Solar Monarch didn’t waste time. This branch was clearly not going to change their mind over mere words.

The only option was to flatten Centurial Peak and eradicate the Chen. He was decisive after gaining the approval of the supreme ancestor.

“Go!” The three legions roared.

“Clank!” Desolate Legion’s members raised their snow-white spears, pointing the sky-piercing tips at the Chen.

“On guard!” The first legion of the Chen summoned shields and stacked them to the front, forming a steel barrier.

“Take it down!” The commander of Desolate Legion rushed forward, harnessing everyone’s power to form an energy spear thrusting like a soaring true dragon.

“Protect the formations!” The Chen channeled their dao power and fused all the shields into one barrier.

“Rumble!” Cracks appeared on the barrier upon contact.

“Smash it!” Solar Legion conjured a solar hammer. Flames poured down from it like heavenly waterfalls.

“Bam!” It broke a hole in the cracked barrier, allowing Desolate Legion to enter.

“Don’t fall behind!” The vanguards of Dragon Legion summoned various treasures - pagodas, gigantic swords, and many others.

The Chen’s first line was obliterated by waves of spears to the front and devastating attacks above from Dragon Legion. The flesh was obliterated, the same for the land.

Corpses rained from the sky and blood spilled to no end in just a short time. The coalition’s goal was not to take down Centurial Peak but rather, Centurial City and Centurial Kingdom.

Since the Chen had focused on defending Centurial Peak, their cities and main kingdom were left undefended.

Spectators saw the carnage and smelled the nauseating stench of blood.

“No mercy.” Even protectors and elders turned pale. Their powerful legions were killing fellow sect members, not the enemies this time.

“Don’t regret your choice.” Dragon-pill entered the battlefield.

The battle had initiated and there was no turning back. The Chen must be eradicated today.

“Boom!” He released his anima tree, blotting out all of Desolate Frontier. He didn’t hold back and let his aura roam freely.

“So be it.” Goldclad and Lostmetal exchanged glances, ready to die with the Chen.

They summoned their anima tree as well. However, their two trees were visibly inferior compared to Dragon-pill’s.
